title: Looking for First Seed Material sprites! (RM2k/2k3)

posts.author: MingnonFiliae
posts.body:
Hello, developer hopeful here.
I am trying to look for RPG Maker 2k/2k3 sprites in the Mack/First Seed Material style, but I've only found a handful of working websites to download them from. These are:
-289k
-Akiroom
-Coastgrove
-Crystal and Moon
-Edengear
-Kurogeki
-Umekobucha
I'm hoping that at least some of you guys can help in gathering more of the Mack-styled sprites from places other than these sites, or have somehow archived ones that I can use. I would be really thankful!

posts.author: GalacticGod
posts.body: 289k was the best one that I have found that still has a bunch up on it.
